predictions.title: If Morgan Rogers leaves Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-07-18 confirms Rogers completes a permanent move right at the end of the World Cup. As of June 23, 2026, Fabrizio Romano confirmed Rogers is Mikel Arteta and Andrea Berta's #1 priority at Arsenal and Nicolo Schira reported an agreement in principle on personal terms until 2031 ahead of £85m–£100m club talks, with Chelsea, Manchester City, Manchester United, and PSG also tracking him.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United during the 2026 summer transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-07-31 confirms Guimaraes departs Newcastle after their 12th-place finish triggered his verbal gentleman's agreement to join a Champions League club. Reuters and Fabrizio Romano reported Manchester United (3rd in PL, replacing Casemiro) held advanced talks over a £60.5m–£69m deal, with Manchester City (losing Bernardo Silva and Rodri), Real Madrid, and PSG as the top UCL rivals.

predictions.title: Which club will Mohamed Salah join first after leaving Liverpool at the end of the 2025–26 season?
predictions.reasoning: Salah left Liverpool as a free agent in June 2026 and will choose his next club after Egypt's World Cup campaign (resolving 2026-08-04). Newly elected Fenerbahce president Aziz Yildirim pledged a $35m/year three-year package after positive talks (making Turkey the 2/1 bookmaker favourite), while Saudi Pro League contenders Al-Ittihad (lost Benzema) and Al-Hilal plus Egyptian-owned MLS club San Diego FC remain strongly in contention.

predictions.title: Which club will Rodri join from Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-08-06 confirms Rodri leaves Manchester City permanently with one year remaining on his contract following Pep Guardiola's departure. Real Madrid (rebuilding under Florentino Perez and Jose Mourinho) have consistently been his primary reported destination as he seeks a return to Spain after the World Cup, while June 2026 reports also link two-time reigning UCL champions PSG along with Barcelona, Atletico Madrid, and Bayern Munich.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Manor Solomon from Tottenham Hotspur during the summer 2026 transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: On June 24, 2026, Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi informed Solomon he is surplus to requirements and available for a cut-price move (resolving 2026-08-08). Leeds United (where he starred with 23 goal involvements in 2024–25) and Fiorentina (his Jan–May 2026 loan club, which his agent insisted in June remains an open option) lead a wide field of mid-table Premier League and European suitors.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Djed Spence on a permanent transfer from Tottenham Hotspur during summer 2026?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-08-12 confirms a permanent exit for Spence, who is behind Porro, Udogie, and new signing Andy Robertson under De Zerbi. predictions.title: Which club will Ollie Watkins join during the 2026 summer transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-08-18 (one week after Villa target Ferran Torres leaves Barcelona) confirms Aston Villa cash in on 30-year-old Watkins (~£30m–£35m) as Unai Emery lowers squad age. Multiple 2026 reports state Newcastle United opened internal talks for Watkins after selling Gordon and seeing Wissa/Woltemade struggle, competing with long-term admirers Manchester United, AC Milan, Arsenal, and Tottenham Hotspur.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-08-19 confirms Konsa leaves Aston Villa permanently amid UEFA/PL financial rules and defensive restructuring. 2026 TEAMtalk reporting specifically linked Konsa with Liverpool (to replace Ibrahima Konate, who left for Real Madrid in June) and Manchester City (to replace John Stones, who also departed on a free transfer in June), alongside Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Savinho from Manchester City during the summer 2026 transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Fabrizio Romano ('Deal on'), Daily Mail, and RTI Esporte all confirm Tottenham Hotspur have agreed personal terms and are in active talks (~£43m–£60m) for Savinho, with the 2026-08-20 completion timing explained by incoming City boss Enzo Maresca waiting to secure a replacement winger first. Newcastle United (monitoring per June reports) and Arsenal (had loan rejected) lead secondary contenders.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Carlos Baleba from Brighton during the 2026 summer transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-08-21 confirms Baleba leaves Brighton permanently as their valuation drops toward £70m. Manchester United already agreed personal terms previously and Baleba discussed joining Old Trafford with Bruno Fernandes and Matheus Cunha in May/June 2026, while Roberto De Zerbi's Tottenham Hotspur are strongly linked as the main rival ahead of post-Rodri Manchester City, Liverpool, and Chelsea.

predictions.title: If Omar Marmoush leaves Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
predictions.reasoning: Both loans and permanent transfers qualify, and early resolution on 2026-08-21 (three days after Ollie Watkins leaves Aston Villa) confirms Marmoush departs after limited starts behind Haaland and Semenyo. 2026 reports name Aston Villa and Tottenham Hotspur as Premier League pole-sitters for a loan/permanent deal, alongside Barcelona (post-Lewandowski), Atletico Madrid (post-Griezmann), and Bayern Munich.

predictions.title: Which club will sign Nicolas Jackson on a permanent transfer from Chelsea during the summer 2026 transfer window?

predictions.title: If Emiliano Martinez leaves Aston Villa on a permanent transfer during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?

predictions.title: If Enzo Fernandez leaves Chelsea permanently during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will sign him?
predictions.reasoning: Early resolution on 2026-08-27 confirms Fernandez secures a permanent exit after Chelsea finished 10th. He has pushed publicly for Real Madrid (with Marca/Schira reporting personal terms in principle and Mourinho requesting him ahead of £120m/player-plus-cash talks), while incoming Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca is his other major suitor—especially once Rodri departs City on August 6.

predictions.title: Which player will command the highest transfer fee paid by a Premier League club during the 2026 summer transfer window?
predictions.reasoning: Manchester City have already tabled a £106m+ (£121m package) bid for Elliot Anderson per The Athletic, with Nottingham Forest seeking £125m–£130m and City losing Rodri on Aug 6. Morgan Rogers is guaranteed to move permanently on July 18 (almost certainly to Arsenal for £85m–£100m+), while £100m-rated Sandro Tonali, Enzo Fernandez (if joining Maresca's Man City on Aug 27), and Bradley Barcola (leaving PSG Aug 27) are strong contenders.
